new: 61-year-old man intubated 9 days for a head injury: T 39.0 C, thick green secretions suctioned from the tube, SpO2 falling on rising FiO2. Film: new left lower-lobe infiltrate; tracheal aspirate grows 10^6 CFU/mL of an oxidase-positive, non-lactose-fermenting gram-negative rod.

Gram-negative coccobacillus; strictly aerobic, non-motile, oxidase-negative and non-fermenting; catalase-positive; forms biofilm and survives up to 5 months on dry surfaces; hard to clear with routine disinfectants; often pan-resistant
